question.question: BLINK's performance on AIDA appears in both the ReFinED paper and the NIL prediction paper. What numbers does each paper give for BLINK on AIDA, and why do they differ?
question.answer: ReFinED's Table 1 lists Wu et al. (2020) at 86.7 on AIDA, marked as normalised accuracy. The NIL paper reports BLINK-cross at 87.49 and BLINK-bi at 82.61 overall accuracy on AIDA without NIL (and 79.58 / 65.01 with NIL). They differ because of the metric (normalised accuracy vs overall accuracy), the training (the NIL paper trains its own BLINK models with BERT-large on AIDA-train), and whether NIL mentions are included.
